_meta.description: RADAR OTel traces data-stream template. A bare Elasticsearch + Kibana (no Fleet/APM integration) ships no template for the traces-generic-default data stream, so the OTel collector's elasticsearch exporter (mapping.mode: otel) cannot create it and every span is rejected. This template is the minimal thing that makes the data stream auto-create. String attributes map to keyword so correlation_id is term-queryable at attributes.correlation_id — the join key the traces plugin and the step-10 done-condition query by. It is NOT Elastic's full APM field set; traces are fully queryable and viewable in Kibana APM via dynamic mappings.
